instruction: A candid outdoor full shot of a sunny park with lush green grass and leafy trees. In the center foreground, the large Black man (R1) in a dark blue t-shirt and dark pants runs forward excitedly with his arms raised and his tongue sticking out. In the left background, the bald man (R2) in a dark blue t-shirt and black pants cheers with raised arms. In the right background, the Black woman with an afro (R6) in a red t-shirt and ripped jeans stands smiling. On the far right, a partially cropped bystander in green is visible. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the scene.
